basis: User authorized iterative diagnostics. Test document-bounded target-position sampling for at most 200 updates on the same 4096 noisy stories and initial interface used in P208; do not read final evaluation or modify protected inputs.
limitations: Single development-side source review; no independent human review; six of 64 sampled stories had serious defects.
Translated synthetic stories are not a high-quality general Chinese or dialogue corpus; full upstream rights remain unverified.
Sampling probabilities, window boundaries and target counts differ from P208; comparison is exploratory, not a controlled causal conclusion.
